description: The FDA granted accelerated approval to Biogen's ADUHELM (aducanumab) for Alzheimer's disease -- the first new Alzheimer's therapy in ~18 years and the first targeting amyloid-beta.

source.verified: Biogen investor press release + Drugs.com FDA approval history + FDA, verified 2026-09-13

event_time_source: FDA accelerated approval date (the approval is the event)
knowable_time_source: FDA approval announced 2021-06-07 (Biogen press release same day). Verified 2026-09-13.
note_on_stamps: For a regulatory approval the event and its disclosure coincide, so event_time == knowable_time -- a third stamp pattern alongside EVT-001 (knowable before event) and EVT-002 (knowable after event).

outcome.note: Regulatory approval (accelerated, contingent on confirmatory studies), not a trial-endpoint result. The drug was later withdrawn by Biogen (2024) -- another revision to the record that bitemporal storage captures.

provenance.fetched_via: web (investor.biogen.com, drugs.com, fda) via agent tools

disclosure_timing_source: FDA accelerated approval announced intraday 2021-06-07; company release same session. (FDA approvals land during/after the session -- procedural.)
